target.statement: IoU of Logistic Regression with fire-area segmentation on the Doubs department at scale s=0.3 (0-day forecast), reported as 0.19 vs grid baseline 0.14

compute.basis: Even the cheapest cell requires the proprietary firefighter-intervention records plus ~15 external feature sources (Meteostat, GEE/Landsat, OSMNX, Kontur, Geodair, vigicrues, eaufrance, firedanger indices) to be re-collected and rasterized at 2 km, then the watershed+K-means segmentation and a 25-config grid search per scale must be re-implemented from a paper that only promises code 'will be released'.

blockers: Firefighter intervention data (Ain/Doubs/Yvelines/Rhône) is not publicly available
Feature pipeline depends on many external services (GEE, Meteostat, Kontur, Geodair, vigicrues, eaufrance) with no provided configs
Code repo link is generic and paper states code 'will be released'; no configs/scripts for the target
Segmentation parameters (max_dilations, intensity_levels) per configuration only in supplementary materials
title: Data-Driven Fire-Zone Segmentation for Improved Short-Term Wildfire Prediction
